description: Returns passages from the kit and book documents a buyer owns, for setup and how-to questions, with the list of files in their order. Requires the order: the download link from the purchase receipt, which contains session_id=cs_. The order is verified as paid with Stripe on each call and only the kits it includes are searched.

order.description: The download link from their receipt, or the cs_ order id in it.
